description: A link that opens the Host.al cart (my.host.al) with a domain registration/transfer or a product already added. Give it to the user: they sign in (or create an account) and pay there with a card (Pago) or PayPal. For .al domains the answer also lists, under before_ordering, the owner details AKEP (the .al registry) requires: tell the user before sending the link, so the order is not refused.

action.description: With "domain": "register" for a new domain (use when check_domain says available), "transfer" to move a domain the user already owns to Host.al.

name: get_order_link
title: Cart link for the user
